title: The Star Inside Earth
hook: You are walking on a thin crust above a hidden star.
script: You are walking on a thin crust above a hidden star. Deep below, a ball of iron roughly 70% the size of the Moon is crystallizing. It grows by one millimeter every year, like a slow-motion freezing process. What if the center of the planet were cooler than we think? It isn't. Earth's inner core runs about 5,400 degrees Celsius. This matches the surface of the Sun. It only stays solid because the pressure is 3.6 million atmospheres. That means the middle of our planet is, temperature for temperature, as hot as the star we orbit.
